title: After the Tenno Sho (Spring): Even After Losing

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro McQueen emerges victorious after a white-hot spring Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But while Ines Fujin makes no secret of her frustration, Mejiro Ryan faces her fans and makes a rousing declaration that reinvigorates both them and herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeing this, Ines senses that Mejiro Ryan is on another level from her, and begins to seriously consider the way she engages with her supporters.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In part to determine whether she has what it takes to reach Ryan's level, Ines decides to throw herself into training for the Takarazuka Kinen!
